purpose: Explicit, reviewable corrections for corrupted rows in the real Bantargebang monthly intake source. ml/scripts/train_models.py applies exactly these entries (nothing silent) and then requires every row to fall within the tonnes-per-trip sanity bounds, so a new bad drop fails loudly instead of skewing the forecaster.

sanity_check.metric: tonase / ritasi (tonnes per trip), per source row
sanity_check.basis: Every uncorrected row outside 2024-01 Jakarta Timur and 2024-04 runs at about 4-7 t per trip (range after correction 2.5-11.6).

corrections.reason: In all 9 rows of 2024-04 the ritasi and tonase columns are swapped (e.g. Jakarta Barat tonase 6612 vs ritasi 43803). Uncorrected, the month reads 1,196 t/day instead of about 7,213 t/day.
corrections.evidence: Uncorrected tonnes per trip for 2024-04 is 0.10-0.29; after the swap it is 3.5-9.9, in line with every other month.

corrections.reason: 5,261.9 t for 8,617 trips is 0.6 t per trip; neighbouring months put Jakarta Timur at about 1,700-1,900 t/day (about 6 t per trip). A misplaced decimal point (52,619.0) is the most likely cause.
corrections.evidence: Inference from tonnes per trip only. NOT confirmed by DLH or data.go.id; ask DLH to confirm. The conservative alternative is to exclude 2024-01 from scoring.

missing_months.handling: Kept as a gap (NaN). Linearly interpolated for model input only; never scored in any backtest.
